# Himalayan Odyssey Expedition

> A local tour operator in Narkanda, Himachal Pradesh, India, offering Spiti Valley, Winter Spiti, Kinnaur and customised Himalayan group and private trips.

Based in Narkanda, Himachal Pradesh 171213, India. Phone and WhatsApp: +91 98169 29669. Services include transport, mountain stays and local ground handling for travel agencies. Confirm current routes, road conditions, availability, inclusions and prices directly before booking. Snowfall and road access are not guaranteed.

## Tour, stay and cab enquiries by destination

- [Spiti Valley tour packages](https://himalayanexpedition.co.in/spiti-valley-tours/): Group tours, backpacking-style road trips, private, family, couple and solo enquiries; 7-night/8-day Kinnaur–Spiti route reference.
- [Winter Spiti expedition](https://himalayanexpedition.co.in/winter-spiti-tours/) and [summer Spiti circuit](https://himalayanexpedition.co.in/summer-spiti-tour/): Snow-season and seasonal Manali–Kunzum–Chandratal route enquiries.
- [Spiti trip cost and inclusions](https://himalayanexpedition.co.in/blog/spiti-valley-tour-cost-2027-guide/): Compare group seat and private trip quotations.
- [Narkanda tour packages and weekend breaks](https://himalayanexpedition.co.in/narkanda-tours/): Local sightseeing, Hatu Peak access checks, winter trips, hotels, homestays, local taxis and combined stay-and-cab quotations.
- [Shimla and Narkanda customised tours](https://himalayanexpedition.co.in/about-us/#shimla-narkanda-services): Family and couple holidays, local sightseeing, overnight stays and onward Kinnaur or Spiti travel enquiries.
- [Vehicles and cabs](https://himalayanexpedition.co.in/#cabs): Narkanda, Shimla and Spiti taxi enquiries, Chandigarh transfers, private SUVs and Tempo Traveller arrangements.
- [Hotels and properties](https://himalayanexpedition.co.in/#gallery): Hotel and homestay enquiries in Himachal; confirm the specific location, property and facilities.
- [Spiti taxi service](https://himalayanexpedition.co.in/spiti-valley-taxi-service/) and [Spiti stays](https://himalayanexpedition.co.in/spiti-valley-hotels-homestays/): Transport-only and accommodation-only bookings can be requested separately.

The business is based in Narkanda in Shimla district, not a claimed separate Shimla-city office. All routes, vehicles, rooms, rates, pickup points and departure availability require confirmation.
